product: VMware Cloud Foundation Automation 9.1 (VM Apps organization)

provenance.statement: VCF Automation publishes no OpenAPI specification. It is absent from the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0), which is why the VCF PowerCLI SDK generates VMware.Sdk.Vcf modules for SddcManager, Ops, Installer and CloudBuilder but none for Automation. docs/contract.json was therefore transcribed by hand from the xAPIs reference pages listed below, each of which was fetched and read on the date recorded against it. A reference page is rendered documentation, not a specification: it can lag the appliance, and in one case (retrieveAuthToken) it carries a security annotation that contradicts the operation's own purpose. Where that happened, docs/contract.json records the discrepancy in a 'note' rather than silently picking a side.

pages.title: Retrieve Auth Token | VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service
pages.usedFor: Method, path, CspLoginSpecification request schema, AuthResponse response schema, and the contradictory security annotation recorded in the contract note.

pages.title: Get Deployments | VM Apps Org - Catalog
pages.usedFor: Method, path, the full documented query parameter set with defaults, minimums and deprecation flags, and the PageOfDeployments response envelope.

pages.title: Request Catalog Item Instances | VM Apps Org - Catalog
pages.usedFor: Method, path, the id path parameter, every CatalogItemRequest property with its type, maxLength and description, the array-of-DeploymentRequest response, and the absence of any idempotency key, precondition header or de-duplication window.

pages.title: Get Deployment By Id | VM Apps Org - Catalog
pages.usedFor: The Deployment schema only. The operation itself is on the contract's excludedOperations list.

pages.title: Submit Deployment Action Request | VM Apps Org - Catalog
pages.usedFor: Read while looking for a retry-safe way to create a deployment. It is a day-2 action on a deployment that already exists, so it is on the contract's excludedOperations list.

pages.title: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Catalog
pages.documents: Service index for the VM Apps organization Catalog API
pages.usedFor: Confirming the operation inventory of the service and its OData-style list conventions ($top, $skip, $orderby, $filter).

pages.title: VMware Cloud Foundation Automation APIs for VM Apps Programming Guide
pages.documents: Background: authentication model and where the API reference lives
pages.usedFor: Corroborating that 'VCF Automation requires an HTTP authentication token in the Authorization request header' and that the reference is published on the Broadcom Developer Portal rather than as a downloadable specification.

pages.title: VCF PowerCLI | Broadcom Developer Portal
pages.usedFor: Confirming which services the auto-generated VCF PowerCLI SDK covers, and therefore that no generated binding exists for VCF Automation.
